notes:
REF-BM-03: Collected title and description can be edited only after the bookmark is saved.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are prevented and the existing card is highlighted, but the user is not taken into an edit flow.
REF-BM-14: Search does not parse #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesized search groups are not implemented.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are not parsed as exact matches.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action interface.
REF-BM-21: There is no action targeting all bookmarks in the current filtered collection.
REF-BM-22: Results always use a fixed created-date order; no sort-key selection exists.
REF-BM-23: Notes are stored and rendered as sanitized rich-text HTML, not Markdown.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are not implemented.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is not implemented.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are not implemented.
